'''''A Floating City''''', or sometimes translated '''''The Floating City''''' ({{langx|fr|Une ville flottante}}), is an adventure novel by French writer [[Jules Verne]] first published in [[1871 in literature|1871]] in France.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Schmidt|first=Johanna de|date=2016-07-01|title='This strange little floating world of ours': shipboard periodicals and community-building in the 'global' nineteenth century|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/journal-of-global-history/article/div-classtitlethis-strange-little-floating-world-of-ours-shipboard-periodicals-and-community-building-in-the-global-nineteenth-centurydiv/0CF0640721884B07A909AEA2A48F0660/core-reader|journal=Journal of Global History|volume=11|issue=2|pages=229–250|doi=10.1017/S1740022816000073|issn=1740-0228|url-access=subscription}}</ref> At the time of its publication, the novel enjoyed a similar level of popularity as ''[[Around the World in Eighty Days]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.questia.com/library/7217226/a-floating-city-the-blockade-runners-round-the-world|title=A Floating City; The Blockade Runners; Round the World in Eighty Days; Dr. Ox's Experiment by Jules Verne, 1911|website=|access-date=|archive-date=2016-12-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161222153456/https://www.questia.com/library/7217226/a-floating-city-the-blockade-runners-round-the-world|url-status=dead}}</ref> The first UK and US editions of the novel appeared in 1874.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.julesverne.ca/vernebooks/jvbkfloat.html|title=Jules Verne: Book: A Floating City, and The Blockade Runners - ANash|last=Nash|first=Andrew|website=www.julesverne.ca|access-date=2016-12-22}}</ref> [[Jules Férat]] provided the original illustrations for the novel.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Evans|first=Arthur B|year=1998|title=The Illustrations of Jules Verne's ''Voyages Extraordinaire''|url=http://scholarship.depauw.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1070&context=mlang_facpubs|journal=Science Fiction Studies|volume=25|pages=241–270|via=DePauw University Library}}</ref>

== Plot ==
[[File:Verne - Une ville flottante, 1872-Cover.png|thumb|432x432px|1872 French book cover]]
It tells of a woman who, on board the ship ''[[SS Great Eastern|Great Eastern]]'' with her abusive husband, finds that the man she loves is also on board.
